column1: # Traction Tool — example torque-ripple map for the Commissioning page's "Import ripple map…" (FW-46).
# Synthetic: a cogging profile of 2.0 N·m at the 6th and 0.8 N·m at the 12th electrical harmonic on a 0.5 N·m mean
# sampled every 5 deg el over one electrical period. Columns: the electrical angle in degrees (the firmware's theta_e
# 0 on the d axis) and the torque ripple measured on the shaft in N·m with no table applied (the firmware's sign).
# The tool resamples it to 36 points (10 deg el)
column2: removes the mean and writes i_q = -(T - mean) / (1.5 pp psi).
